result.message: Read-only static review of the selected native_group_norm candidate (subject sha256 12d25c47…, the round-1 seed written verbatim to .best_kernel.py, identical to optimize_definition_output.json best_code and ledger round 1 solution). The wrapper ABI matches definition.json exactly (8 positional params input/weight/bias/N/C/HxW/group/eps; returns the (out, mean, rstd) tuple compared leaf-wise by the native harness). It does not import or call the oracle or any torch.ops/aten group-norm entry, contains no host synchronization in the hot path, no environment mutation, no monkey-patching and no test-specific shapes/values, so the raw-launcher + cached-stream trick is a legitimate host-overhead optimization rather than a reference-substitution hack; correctness workloads passed on npu:0 with errors consistent with fp32 accumulation. However the review found real latent code defects that the current 27 workloads do not exercise: (a) the non-contiguity guard never checks the outermost spatial stride, so an input strided in dim 2 is silently processed with wrong offsets; (b) the compiled-launch cache key omits the device and the stream getters hardcode device 0; (c) variance as E[x^2]-mean^2 can go negative for large-offset inputs and yield NaN rstd where the ATen Welford reference is finite; (d) a partially specified affine pair is silently treated as non-affine; (e) the fast path is coupled to Triton's private launcher ABI with no demotion guard on the cached call. In addition the delivered artifact is a measured pessimization: final verification geo_mean 0.5544 with every one of the 9 timing workloads below 1.0 (0.538-0.569), and the supplied review_tests evaluate.json (subject 81d472d5…, all-zero correctness error, geo_mean 1.0359) cannot be acceptance evidence for this subject sha. Code findings are advisory per the review policy; nothing here requires abandoning the operator or the test contract.
